cuts.raw_narration: Kite confirms that the creature that attacked Gon was a chimera ant, a dangerous insect under designated quarantine level one that normally no one is allowed to be near.

Kite's team warns that the chimera ant queen has a voracious appetite, eating many times her body weight in a single day. Judging by the size of the claw, this queen is at least two meters long, big enough to eat a human in no time at all.

In a sun-dappled forest flashback, a nine-year-old boy named Kurt is told by his mother how reliable he already is, and asked to keep looking after his little sister Reina. Kurt vows he will keep both of them safe no matter what happens.

Inside a dark rocky cave, the towering Chimera Ant Queen addresses her newly hatched soldiers, declaring her solemn duty to give birth to the king and demanding they bring her large quantities of highly nutritious food.

The Queen feasts in her cave, murmuring that this species is delicious and the best fodder she has tasted. Beside her stands a chimera ant soldier, and Kurt's blood-stained blue vest lies abandoned on the floor as she declares she must consume more of this species.

The Queen names a newly hatched offspring that can speak as her squadron leader and orders it to capture more of the highly nutritious organisms she has tasted. The narration reveals that a chimera ant has now been born with human genes, and Kite's worst fears have finally come to pass.
